messages:
meera: Quick sync note: I'm assembling the private-deploy networking playbook focused on two pain points we keep hearing — overlapping customer CIDRs (NAT-edge) and stable IP semantics across rolling upgrades. Need alignment on API shape, preseed signing, and launch checklist.

lucas: put the goals in bullets? makes it easier to scope.

meera: Goals: 1) stable lease semantics (reattachable lease_id), 2) IPAM HTTP contract for installer & console, 3) DNS modes: customer-pull vs redwood-push-with-consent, 4) preseed + signing for airgap, 5) upgrade choreography that preserves firewall rules.

ari: For DNS, recommend we support a "declarative zone manifest" that customers can opt to fetch from a signed URL. That avoids us having write-permissions into their zones.

sam: Agreed. For IPAM API minimal shape:
```
POST /v1/leases/allocate
body: { "pool_id": "cust-123", "cidr_hint": "10.1.4.0/24", "sticky_key": "node-uuid" }
resp: { "ip": "10.1.4.12", "lease_id": "L-abc123", "gw": "10.1.4.1", "ttl": 86400 }
```
Also: GET /v1/leases?owner=node-uuid, POST /v1/leases/release {lease_id}. Need metrics: leases_total, leases_stale, lease_reclaim_ops.

julia: On preseed: schema must include leases, dns_manifest_checksum, installer_version, signed_by. We'll sign with infra key and include signature in metadata so upgrades can validate origin.

meera: Upgrade choreography sketch: stage 0 canary (single replica, smoke evals), stage 1 phased in-region rollout (maintain lease affinity), stage 2 full rollout. During node replacement flow we MUST try to rebind lease_id to the new node before changing IPs; if impossible, we fallback to NAT-edge for that tenant.

ari: NAT-edge: customers may bring 10/8. We'll support NAT at edge for specific tenants as a GA stretch. For GA require non-overlapping or documented NAT config. We must document performance and port-limit tradeoffs.

lucas: Firewall-friendly plan: avoid changing IPs for long-lived endpoints during control-plane upgrades. If data-plane change forces IP swap, emit a diff and provide a 24h dual-stack grace window where both old and new IPs are routed (via LB rules).

sam: Suggest adding an operator endpoint: POST /v1/leases/force-attach {lease_id, node_id} with RBAC audit. Useful for recovery.

legalbot: reminder: DNS automation requires explicit customer consent in contract; product should surface that consent flow and audit trail.

julia: UX: console preview of DNS diffs with a checkbox that records consent + audit log entry. Also make preview available for signed preseed files so operators can inspect before applying.

opsbot: task-bot: created tasks: IPAM spec draft, preseed schema + signing impl, DNS manifest format, upgrade runbook prototype, console diff mockups.

meera: Launch criteria (GA):
- IPAM allocate/release/rebind endpoints implemented + unit tests
- Preseed file format + signature verification in installer
- DNS manifest read-mode validated with one onprem and one VPC customer
- Upgrade runbook verified in staging (canary + phased) with golden smoke prompts
- Console preview + consent flow implemented (minimal UX)
- Observability: lease metrics + dns_diff_alerts configured

ari: Priority list: P0 = IPAM reattach (lease stability) + preseed signing. P1 = DNS manifest + console preview. P2 = NAT-edge and paid non-disruptive upgrade mode.

lucas: Dependencies: installer (parsing + signature check), infra (lease store + reclaim), devex (console preview), legal (consent text). I'll add to the dependency board and tag owners.

sam: small note: include sample golden prompts set for smoke eval (latency + correctness checks) in the runbook. Will add examples to the doc.

meera: Thanks. Julia, can you push preseed schema by EOD? Sam, can you draft sample smoke prompts? I'll run the sync tomorrow 11:30am PT to finalize scope.

opsbot: reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 1725096399 (calendar invite sent). :calendar:

meera: perfect, thanks everyone.
